reason: I forget pills at home all the time and travel a lot, so a counted sachet in my bag is the first version of this that fits how I live. Named lab and a report for my batch is more than most brands show me, and the empty-box refund makes one box a cheap try.
objection: I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles. I want to open that QR report myself and see it is a real lab and the numbers match the box, not just a nice page.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR report did not open, named no real lab, or the batch number did not match the box, I would not buy again.
